reading.ru: Слушайте это все народы, внимайте все живущие на земле, и простые, и знатные, равно и богатые, и бедные
reading.question: Who is being addressed in this verse?
options: All peoples and all inhabitants of the earth, both common and noble, rich and poor
Only the kings and rulers
Only the poor and weak
Only the wise and learned
reading.correct: All peoples and all inhabitants of the earth, both common and noble, rich and poor
reading.explain: The verse addresses все народы, все живущие на земле (all peoples, all inhabitants), listing all social classes.

reading.ru: Чего мне бояться в дни бедствия, когда злые лжецы меня окружают
reading.question: What is the speaker protected from?
options: Times of trouble and wicked deceivers surrounding him
Darkness and silence
His own weakness and failure
The anger of his family
reading.correct: Times of trouble and wicked deceivers surrounding him
reading.explain: The speaker asks why fear times of trouble when surrounded by wicked liars, implying divine protection.

reading.ru: Никто не в силах искупить брата или дать Богу выкуп за его жизнь
reading.question: What is impossible according to this verse?
options: No one can redeem another or give God a ransom for their life
No one can become wise
No one can find water in the desert
No one can remember the past
reading.correct: No one can redeem another or give God a ransom for their life
reading.explain: Никто не в силах искупить брата или дать Богу выкуп за его жизнь — No one has the power to redeem or offer ransom to God.

reading.ru: Выкуп за жизнь велик, не найдется платы такой, чтобы он остался вовеки жить и не увидел могилы
reading.question: What does the verse explain about redemption?
options: Redemption is costly and no price can buy eternal life and escape from death
Redemption is easy and available to everyone
Redemption requires only prayer
Redemption is not necessary
reading.correct: Redemption is costly and no price can buy eternal life and escape from death
reading.explain: The verse states that redemption is expensive and no payment exists that would allow someone to live forever and avoid the grave.

reading.ru: Каждый видит, что мудрые умирают, вместе гибнут глупец и невежда, оставляя богатство свое другим
reading.question: What happens to all people regardless of wisdom or foolishness?
options: Everyone dies and leaves their wealth to others
Only the foolish die, the wise live forever
The wise escape death through knowledge
Death only takes the poor
reading.correct: Everyone dies and leaves their wealth to others
reading.explain: The verse explicitly states that мудрые умирают, вместе гибнут глупец и невежда (both wise and foolish perish), оставляя богатство (leaving their wealth).

reading.ru: Не завидуй, когда человек богатеет, и слава его дома множится
reading.question: What advice is given?
options: Do not envy a man when he becomes rich and his house's glory multiplies
Work hard to become as rich as others
Be jealous of those who have more
Pursue wealth above all things
reading.correct: Do not envy a man when he becomes rich and his house's glory multiplies
reading.explain: The verse directly commands: Не завидуй (do not envy) when человек богатеет (a man becomes rich) and слава его дома множится (his household's glory increases).
